There are many [[lighthouse]]s along the long coastline of [[India]] and in the associated [[List of islands of India|islands]]. They are administered by the Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, [[Government of India]] whose headoffice is located in [[Noida]].

They are categorized for administrative reasons into nine directorates: [[Gandhidham]], [[Jamnagar]], [[Mumbai]], [[Goa]], [[Kochi|Cochin]], [[Chennai]], [[Visakhapatnam]], [[Kolkata]] and [[Port Blair]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Location of our offices|url=http://dgll.nic.in/Content/64_1_Introduction.aspx|publisher=Directorate General of Lighthouses & Lightships|accessdate=8 April 2014}}</ref>
